title: the daemon answers but the node is logged out: a distinct reason key
titleZh: 守护进程有响应但节点已登出:必须用不同的 reasonKey
why: A logged-out node needs one specific human action (sign in) and nothing else. Merging this with the pipe-denied case would destroy that hint, so the two must stay distinguishable. It must still be unknown rather than blocked: the collector cannot fix a login, and a blocked verdict without a possible fix invites improvised changes.
inject: 'tailscale ip -4' exits 1 with the logged-out text
